h: History at the end of the line
p: Uxbridge sits at the far western end of both the Metropolitan and Piccadilly lines, and its High Street is a proper town-centre shopping street with The Chimes and The Pavilions shopping centres either side. This Admiral is an adult gaming centre, 18+ only.

Uxbridge has a big piece of wartime history close by. The Battle of Britain Bunker, at the former RAF Uxbridge site, is the underground operations room from which No. 11 Group directed fighters during 1940, and its visitor centre is well worth an hour or two. The Grand Union Canal also passes the edge of town, with a towpath for a walk, and the Colne Valley regional park beyond offers lakes and countryside.
